independent_software.interface: env.do(lambda obs: forced_action) returns obs,reward,terminated,truncated,info; pre-action obs must be recorded explicitly BEFORE do()
independent_software.dependency_behavior: May rely on Gymnasium and NumPy; no import, package install, upstream execution or action performed at P80 engineering gate
independent_software.independence_limit: Third-party source code is independently maintained; source code origin does not prove independent outcome custody or fair evaluation.

intervention_trace.record_kind: observed actual do-mode transitions only; no counterfactual, unrealized or natural-action-only samples

constraints.observations: finite 4D real vectors; state_after[i] equals state_before[i+1] with absolute tolerance<=1e-5
constraints.reward: finite scalar; boolean termination/truncation only on final transition
constraints.probe_event_ids: unique subset of 2..N; derived from ACTUALLY EXECUTED next transitions, not independent counterfactual branches or unseen fake effects
constraints.witness: each event needs provenance receipt_ref, source_id, producer_id and upstream exact SHA metadata; self-attested receipts do not prove witnessing
constraints.no_oracle: no hidden wind, change labels or future state in historical action key

embedding.purpose: Deterministic unsupervised fixed state+action key and next-delta effect for P79 16D schema; this is NOT original native 16D physical action. Report input semantics as state-action context.
embedding.key_formula: unit_l2([1, tanh(pre_state_j / scale_j) for j=0..3, onehot(actual_discrete_action,2), 0 repeated 9])
embedding.effect_formula: [tanh((next_state_j - pre_state_j)/scale_j) j=0..3, tanh(realized_reward), int(terminated), int(truncated), zeros 9]
embedding.invariants: All transformation parameters fixed before data use; no training or adaptation, no hidden wind/counterfactual; no privileged fields, probe targets excluded from history before indexed prefix.
embedding.metric_caveat: 16D padded MSE is not a physically meaningful or balanced total metric; eventual scientific evaluation must separately report four state deltas, reward, termination, per-channel weights and normalized untransformed scales with preregistration.
embedding.information: action key includes pre-state and executed discrete action, unlike P78's unit continuous action; not same task and cannot claim matched representation or action-only transfer.

p79_export.events: one factual event per actual logged transition; receipt_ref preserved verbatim; all historical events are available only when time becomes past
p79_export.probes: for logged transition with 1-based event_id k>=2, probe.after_events=k-1, query built from its state_before+actual action, target built from its already realized state_after/reward; replay must read before the event is written to history
p79_export.group: unknown; never infer changed/stable from action stream absent independently witnessed intervention
p79_export.manifest: source_kind=external_simulator, SHA256 canonical event worlds; source_id/producer_id/custody_ref supplied and validated, NOT independently attested
p79_export.first_use: Actual source raw conversion can be schema-validated, but NEVER model-scored without independent project owner first-use and exact-GitHub qualification.

engineering_tests: Mock/fictional two-state CartPole-style transition data only; never import or run upstream environment
No-score adapter with canonical deterministic source digest and strict P79 schema consistency
Pre/post action-effect shape/dtype, norm, finite, chronology, terminal containment, receipt and ID guard
Probe at event k reads only events < k, and exact actual event k target is present only as a read-only scoring label
Actions and intervened effects not silently synthesized, no future output or hidden wind included
Source-upstream commit and path are constant/pinned but NOT proof of actual software used by log producer
Source_id and checksum spoofing risks disclosed; engine-side external scoring must remain forbidden
Full final candidate SHA pinned CPU Windows/Linux G4/G5/G7 plus original regression; no scientific first-use or auto-scheduled owners
